title: From evals/make_tasks.py: py-parse-duration
prompt: parse_duration() in duration.py should turn strings like '1h30m', '45s', '2d' or '1d2h3m4s' into a number of seconds, but it gives wrong answers. Fix it. Raise ValueError for anything that is not one or more number+unit pairs using only d, h, m or s: an empty string, 'abc', '5x' and a bare number like '10' must all raise. Run the tests when done. Do not edit the existing test files.
